guides.title: Golden Glaives — Watchtower Timing
guides.summary: Complete-but-don't-claim strategy to carry Watchtower rewards into event scoring
guides.note: Complete the 08:00 tasks but don't claim — hold the reward. Skip 16:00 entirely so those tasks are fresh at Monday's event-start reset. Claim everything at 00:00 Monday when Golden Glaives scoring goes live.
